parsed_payload.reasoning: Group moves in blocks of four: (4k+1)N, (4k+2)E, (4k+3)S, (4k+4)W. Each block contributes net y=(4k+1)-(4k+3)=-2 and net x=(4k+2)-(4k+4)=-2. For moves 1-40 there are 10 blocks, giving 20 cm South and 20 cm West. Move 41 adds 41 cm North. Net displacement is 41-20=21 cm North and 20 cm West. Distance = sqrt(21^2+20^2)=sqrt(841)=29 cm.
